questions.stem: A 25-year pregnant lady presents with easy fatigue in 2nd trimester, CBC shows RBC count 3.3 million, Hb 10g/dL, MCH 24, MCV 72, MCHC 29, Retic count 1.8%. What is the next line of management in her
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) microcytic anemia with low RBC count we think of IDA.

questions.stem: A variant of sickle cell anemia which will lead to more severe vascular crisis is

options.label: C
options.text: Sickle cell anemia with hereditary persistent HbF

questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (D) HbSC disease is a compound heterozygous condition which has HbS mutation on one Allele and HbC mutation on another allele. HbC precipitates sickling thus causes more severe vascular crisis.

True about the disease is? 1) Males and females are equally affected2) Decreased reduced glutathione3) Decrease production of NADP4) Decreased ROS scavenging5) Supravital stains are helpful
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B)

questions.stem: Which of the following is correct chronological order of changes in iron deficiency anemia1) Decreased serum iron2) Increased TIBC3) Decreased ferritin4) Decreased transferrin saturation
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C)

questions.stem: A 32-year male, painter by profession presented with anemia, Hb 10, MCH 24, MCV 70. He was treated with oral iron preparation for 2 months and no improvement is seen. His Serum iron is increased. Which of the following should constitute his treatment?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) Increased Serum iron suggest there is iron overload and patient is having microcytic anemia which is suggestive of sideroblastic anemia. Vitamin B6 (pyridoxin deficiency is one of the cause for it.

questions.stem: A patient presents has fatigue, petechiae and purpura for many months, now has presented with dark urine in early morning sample. Coombs test is negative. Hb 10, MCH 28, MCV 80, Platelet count 45000, Retic counts 5%. Which of the following investigations will help to arrive at diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) patient has hemoglobinuria and thrombocytopenia

questions.stemHtml: A patient presented with anemia after gastrectomy. Clinical examination is as follows. Which of the following is not true about the disease

options.label: A
options.text: Oral vitamin B12 supplements will help

options.label: B
options.text: PBS will show hyper segmented neutrophils

questions.answerText: Oral vitamin B12 supplements will help
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) Hyperpigmented knuckles are seen in vitamin B12 deficiency and this after gastrectomy is due to intrinsic factor deficiency thus oral B12 wont help.

questions.stem: True about reticulocytes in peripheral blood are all except
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) reticulocytes are stained by Methylene blue or Brillian cresyl blue not Prussian blue which is a stain for iron

questions.stem: A 25-year lady working at call centre has presented with easy fatigue. Hb 9g/dL, MCH 31, MCV 110 retic count 1.2%. Further history suggests that due her odd working hours she cannot prepare food at home and s and most of the time orders food online which mostly is junk. Serum folate levels are low, B12 levels low normal. Which of the following should be appropriate treatment to her?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) macrocytic anemia with folate deficiency are treated with both B12 and folic acid (B9) other wise there is a risk of neuropathy precipitating.

questions.stem: Staging used in BCLL SLL is
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) Ann Arbor staging for lymphoma, Masaoka staging= thymoma, international staging system=Multiple Myeloma

questions.stem: Which of the following is not true about acute myeloid leukaemia

options.label: B
options.text: Blast should be at least 20% for diagnosis

options.label: C
options.text: Blasts may be <20% if genetic abnormalities are present

options.label: D
options.text: Proliferation Precursor myeloid cells in Bone Marrow

questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) AML are common in adults (3-5th decade) while ALL is common in children.

questions.stemHtml: Serum electrophoresis of an asymptomatic patient who shows 12% plasma cells in BM is as follows which of the following is most likely diagnosis
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) BM shows 12% plasma cells it cant be MGUS (which shows <10% plasma cells). Electrophoresis shows a very strong band of lambda and faint Kappa ( suggesting lambda is very high= monoclonal) even IgA band is very strong as compared to other Ig.

questions.stem: A 2-year boy presents with recurrent knee effusions which are very painful. Examination shows multiple ecchymotic patches over skin. BT 5 min, CT 10 min, PT 13 seconds, APTT 55 seconds. Most likely diagnosis
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) elevated APTT suggests intrinsic pathway defect although option A, B C are intrinsic pathway defects incidence of hemophilia A is more.

questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) this newborn has bleeding with all times normal suggesting factor XIII deficiency which are treateb by rcmbinant factor XIII or cryoprcipitate.
